row.amal_said: So you could either say my favorite stone or my favorite using عندي. المفضل عندي. ... الـ، المفضل عندي.
row.why: 'My favorite' standing alone is المفضل عندي (adjective with el-); he said مفضل لي, Amal gave المفضل عندي and prompted 'الـ' again at 54:25 when he repeated مفضل عندي.
row.english: the second stone was my favorite

rulings.why: A7 (adjective and where el- sits) covers the el- she prompted; same rule as agreed A30, so no PROPOSE needed.

row.amal_said: But al-mufaddal is an adjective, so it follows ders. ... هاد الدرس المفضل عندي.
row.why: Again 'my favorite' without el-; Amal named the rule (al-mufaddal is an adjective, follows ders) and gave هاد الدرس المفضل عندي. New sentence 4 min after 54:09, so a separate row.

rulings.why: She named the adjective rule; A7 fits.

row.amal_said: مش هون. مش، مش في. مش هون. ... في is not is. في is there is.

rulings.why: Her explanation is about في wrongly standing in for 'is' (no 'to be' in Arabic) - grammar C1, not a missing word for 'here'.
